title: Ansible Collection
items: What does the IBM Storage Virtualize Ansible collection provide?
A series of Ansible modules and plugins for interacting with IBM Storage Virtualize family products
Ansible Collection 提供一系列 Ansible Module 與 Plugin，用來與 IBM Storage Virtualize 系列產品互動。
What is the name of the IBM Storage Virtualize collection on Ansible Galaxy?
Collection 發佈於 Ansible Galaxy，名稱為 ibm.storage_virtualize。
Where is the official documentation for the collection located?
官方文件位於 galaxy.ansible.com 的 ibm/storage_virtualize/docs。
How do the modules in the IBM Storage Virtualize Ansible collection connect to the storage system?
Collection 的 Module 透過 REST API 連線到 IBM Storage Virtualize 系統。
Which minimum Ansible version is required for IBM Storage Virtualize modules?
使用 IBM Storage Virtualize Module 需 Ansible 2.16 以上。
Which Python version is required on the Ansible control node?
Ansible Control Node 需要 Python 3.10 以上。
Does Ansible require agents on managed nodes?
Yes, a daemon on every node
Ansible 是 Agentless 架構，不需在被管理節點安裝 Agent 或 Daemon。
Which platform is recommended and officially supported for the Ansible control node?
官方建議的 Control Node 平台為 Linux；WSL 可做基本工作但不一定適合正式環境。
What is Red Hat Ansible Tower now called?
Red Hat Ansible Tower 已更名為 Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform，其 Automation Controller 取代原 Tower 功能。
The foundational automation engine providing the CLI framework, modules, and plug-ins
Ansible Core 是 Ansible 的基礎自動化引擎，提供命令列框架、Module 與 Plug-in。
In Ansible terminology, what is a playbook?
A framework where automation tasks are defined, written in YAML
Playbook 是以 YAML 撰寫、定義 Ansible 自動化工作的框架。
簡報 S3；RedBook 自動化 Ch5.2.4
In Ansible terminology, what is the inventory?
A file that contains Ansible client and server data
Inventory 是包含 Ansible Client 與 Server 資料的檔案。
What is a handler in Ansible?
A task that is called only if a notifier is present
Handler 是只有在有 Notifier 呼叫時才執行的 Task。
A hub for finding and sharing Ansible content
Ansible Galaxy 是尋找與分享 Ansible 內容的平台。
A structured way of grouping tasks, handlers, variables, and other properties
User permissions on the storage system
Roles 是將 Task、Handler、變數與其他屬性結構化分組的方式。
Which IBM products can the collection manage?
SAN Volume Controller, FlashSystem family, Storwize family, and Storage Virtualize for Public Cloud
可管理 IBM SAN Volume Controller、以 Storage Virtualize 建構的 FlashSystem、Storwize 與 Storage Virtualize for Public Cloud。
Which task is a typical use of Ansible playbooks with IBM Storage Virtualize?
Automating repetitive configuration and management tasks
適合以 Playbook 將重複的設定與管理工作自動化，提升一致性並降低人為錯誤。
簡報 S3；RedBook 自動化 Ch5.2.5
Which migration workflow is provided as a sample playbook in the collection?
範例 Playbook 包含 HyperSwap 移轉到 Policy-based HA、GM 與 GMCV 移轉到 Policy-based Replication 等流程。
What must be installed to use the ibm_svctask_command and ibm_svcinfo_command modules?
使用 ibm_svctask_command 與 ibm_svcinfo_command 需安裝 Paramiko (Python 的 SSHv2 實作)。
How do the ibm_svcinfo_command and ibm_svctask_command modules run commands?
這兩個 Module 透過 SSH Session 在系統上執行 svcinfo 與 svctask CLI 指令。
What can happen when querying more than 2,000 objects through the REST API?
API service stability can be affected and the service might restart
透過 REST API 查詢超過 2,000 個物件可能影響 API 服務穩定性，服務可能因記憶體限制自動重啟。
RedBook 自動化 Ch5.2.6 Current limitations
Is REST API access through a cluster IPv6 address supported by the collection?
不支援透過叢集 IPv6 位址存取 REST API。
For which systems is automated acceptance of license agreements (EULA) supported?
自 1.8.0 起自動接受 EULA 只支援 LMC 系統，非 LMC 系統須於 GUI 首次登入精靈接受。
Which minimum IBM Storage Virtualize software version is required to use the collection?
Which command installs the collection from Ansible Galaxy?
以 `ansible-galaxy collection install ibm.storage_virtualize` 安裝；加上 --force 可升級。
How do you upgrade the collection to the latest version?
Add --force to the ansible-galaxy collection install command
以 `ansible-galaxy collection install ibm.storage_virtualize --force` 升級。
Which network access is required from the controller node?
To the IBM Storage Virtualize management IP
Controller Node 必須能連到 IBM Storage Virtualize 的 Management IP。
Which module generates an authentication token for a user?
ibm_svc_auth 為使用者產生驗證 Token。
Which module completes the initial setup for LMC systems?
ibm_svc_complete_initial_setup 完成 LMC 系統的初始設定；非 LMC 系統需登入 GUI 完成 Day 0。
ibm_svc_manage_volume 管理 Standard Volume；ibm_svc_vdisk 自 1.6.0 起已淘汰。
Which module is deprecated starting with version 1.6.0?
自 1.6.0 起 ibm_svc_vdisk 視為淘汰，改用 ibm_svc_manage_volume。
Which module manages volume mappings to hosts?
ibm_svc_vol_map 管理 Volume 對 Host 的 Mapping。
Which module manages FlashSystem grid operations?
ibm_sv_manage_flashsystem_grid 管理 FlashSystem Grid 作業。
Which module manages policy-based replication configuration?
ibm_sv_manage_replication_policy 管理 Policy-based Replication；ibm_svc_manage_replication 管理 Remote Copy。
Which module switches the replication direction?
ibm_sv_switch_replication_direction 切換 Replication 方向。
ibm_sv_manage_snapshotpolicy 管理 Snapshot Policy；ibm_sv_manage_snapshot 管理 Snapshot。
Which module manages clones and thin-clones of volumes and volume groups?
ibm_sv_manage_clone 管理 Volume 與 Volume Group 的 Clone 與 Thin-clone。
Which module collects information about the IBM Storage Virtualize system?
ibm_svc_info 用於收集系統資訊，可自動化並簡化資訊蒐集。
In the ibm_svc_info module, which parameter specifies the list of entity types to retrieve?
gather_subset 指定要取得資訊的 Storage Virtualize 物件類型清單。
RedBook 自動化 ibm_svc_info Key parameters
Which ibm_svc_info parameter lets you run svcinfo commands not yet part of gather_subset, such as lspartnershipcandidate?
command_list 可直接指定尚未納入 gather_subset 的 svcinfo 指令。
Which ibm_svc_info parameter returns only objects that match attribute values?
filtervalue 指定一或多個篩選條件，只顯示符合的物件，可減少網路用量與 Playbook 解析。
What happens when gather_subset and objectname are both set to all?
The module returns detailed output for all objects across all supported entities
兩者都設為 all 時，會輸出所有支援物件類型的全部物件詳細資訊。
How does ibm_svc_info handle entities not supported by the current code level?
It returns a null value instead of failing
遇到目前版本不支援的物件時回傳 null 而非失敗，確保自動化流程不中斷 (向下相容)。
Which filtervalue retrieves only drives in candidate state?
範例 5-5 以 gather_subset: drive 與 filtervalue: "use=candidate" 取得 candidate 狀態的 Drive。
Which command shows online documentation for a specific module?
以 `ansible-doc` 加 Collection 與 Module 名稱顯示說明與範例。
What is the default buffer size for thin-provisioned and compressed volumes in ibm_svc_manage_volume?
buffersize 預設為 2%，需搭配 thin 或 compressed 參數使用。
Which Ansible feature protects sensitive data such as storage credentials?
Ansible Vault 以加密檔案保存帳密等敏感資料，避免以明碼存放。
Which command creates an encrypted variable file?
以 `ansible-vault create secrets.yml` 建立加密的變數檔。
Which file can be configured to use SCP instead of SFTP for module transfer?
若 SSH 可用但 SFTP 不支援，可在 ansible.cfg 設定改用 SCP。
